approaches.title: Fixed-range presence tracking
approaches.summary: Track which input values occur in a bounded boolean array, then scan positive multiples of k until finding the first unseen one.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial solution scaffold with no implementation.
Implemented boolean presence tracking and scanned multiples of k through the fixed value range.
Simplified the scan by continuing while multiples remain in range and are present, returning the first missing multiple.
